title: LiveRig Configuration
description: Defines a rig's keyboards, parameter banks, patches, and stems so the controller no longer assumes a fixed 4-keyboard / 8-patch / 4-stem layout.

version.description: Schema version, bump on breaking changes.

rigName.description: Friendly name for this rig config, e.g. 'Main Live Rig' or 'Festival Backup'.

keyboards.description: Replaces the hardcoded KBD 1-4 pages. One entry per physical/virtual keyboard page.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'kbd1'. Used as a key elsewhere — do not reuse across keyboards.

label.description: Display name shown in the UI, e.g. 'KBD 1'.

bankSize.description: Number of parameters walked per bank when paging through a device's parameters.

midiChannel.description: 1-indexed MIDI channel for this keyboard. Omit to auto-assign (ch1-4 for KBD1-4, then walking free channels skipping reserved ones).

defaultTrackBinding.description: Track name or index this keyboard binds to by default on load. Null = unbound until user selects a track.

buttonCount.description: Number of on/off buttons exposed by this keyboard page (replaces hardcoded 16).

faderCount.description: Number of continuous faders exposed by this keyboard page (replaces hardcoded 8).

faderRange.description: MIDI CC value range for faders on this page.

patches.description: Replaces hardcoded 8-patch assumption for snapshot/rename feature.

maxPatches.description: Number of patch slots available for CAPTURE/RENAME.

restoreAnimation.description: Tuning for the fader-restore animation when a patch is recalled.

captureScope.description: Which keyboard ids are eligible as a capture/restore scope. Defaults to all keyboard ids in this config.

stems.description: Replaces hardcoded 4-stem assumption. Empty/omitted if this rig doesn't use stem control.

trackName.description: Ableton track name this stem control targets (case-insensitive match). Null = slot deliberately unconfigured.

loopers.description: Dedicated Looper-device tracks controlled from the Looper page. Omit if unused.

trackName.description: Ableton track holding the Looper device (case-insensitive match).

markerTrack.description: Name of the Arrangement track whose named clips define song sections (feeds the Transport section strip and lighting cues). Case-insensitive match.

lighting.description: OSC lighting cues fired by the bridge when the playhead enters a new markerTrack section (2026-07-06). Console-agnostic: works with anything listening for OSC (grandMA3, Eos, ChamSys, Onyx, Lightkey, QLC+, Resolume...).

enabled.description: Master switch. When false (or the whole lighting key is absent), the bridge sends nothing.

oscHost.description: IP/hostname of the lighting console or software.

oscPort.description: UDP port the console listens for OSC on.

sendSectionName.description: Send /liverig/section <name(string)> <index(int)> on every section change (index -1 / empty name = outside all sections).

sendProgress.description: Also stream /liverig/progress <0.0-1.0(float)> ~10 Hz while playing -- lets the console run timed fades across a section.

cues.description: Optional per-section console-specific messages, keyed by section name (case-insensitive). Value is either an OSC address string, or {address, args} with int/float/string args.

listeners.description: Global guardrails learned the hard way — keep these enforced regardless of rig size.

useSchedulePollForSongTime.description: current_song_time fires per audio block; must be polled via schedule_message, never subscribed directly.

wrapListenersInTryExcept.description: Every listener subscription must be defensively wrapped to avoid 'Observer already connected' errors.
